```txt
Document type: BA-grade area specification
Audience: reviewer, maintainer, implementation agent
Purpose: One authority for fgOS repository operations and recovery in every domain
Design status: Accepted G0, D-ADR0057 (2026-10-18). Owner answered Q1-Q7 and R30 on 2026-10-17; proofs runnable at G0 re-checked 2026-10-18 (§19).
Implementation status: Linux Rust Publication, the durable WAL and its read-only scan, combined Node addon/release manifest support, controller-owned activation fence/C5 admission, and Rust RepositoryConfig.ensure_fetch_mapping (additive local mirror refspecs with WAL URL provenance) are implemented. The Node ensureFetchMapping binding, six Git doctor rows (including the single combined ABI/floor row), read-only WAL health inspection and registered WAL/mirror-mapping setup fixes are implemented. Dormant Refs and non-event Remote ports (Rust, combined addon and Node facades), opaque one-shot holder handover, and linked-cwd Inspect discovery with reciprocal registration validation are implemented. The Worktree port (create/detached allocation, guarded removal/relocation, orphan inspection and operation-specific registration recovery) and public create verb are implemented; other checkout mutation ports and the Node writer migration remain pending; the Rust replacement is not complete.
Canonical: Yes (docs/platform/git/spec.md)
Owner: Git component
Source (proposed): packages/git/rust, crate fgos-git
Node facade (proposed): src/git/; every Node-reachable Git operation goes through one combined
 N-API addon that links fgos-event-store and fgos-git (owner decision Q1)
Contracts (proposed): packages/git/contracts/
Dependencies: holder-lock, process facts/control, Session Identity, hardened Git CLI
Related: docs/platform/event-store/spec.md; docs/platform/holder-lock/spec.md;
 docs/platform/component-boundary.md; docs/specs/runner.md;
 docs/platform/packaging-distribution/README.md; docs/specs/distribution.md;
 plans/reports/brief-261017-1907-git-g0-spec-council-inputs.md;
 plans/reports/research-261017-1032-git-lessons-catalogue.md
```
